items.title: Ogilvy and CAA launch partnership to clone celebrity talent for AI ads
items.excerpt: Ogilvy and CAA launched Echo, a consent-first partnership that lets brands license AI-generated digital doubles of CAA talent such as Terry Crews for ads across the web.

items.title: ChatGPT is about to show brands their mention count
items.excerpt: OpenAI is testing a ChatGPT dashboard that counts how often a business appears in answers and the clicks those mentions send to its site, giving marketers a first-party AI-visibility metric.

items.title: OpenAI’s Monetization Chief to Ad Partners: User Trust Means Some Things ‘We Just Can’t’ Do
items.excerpt: OpenAI's monetization chief told ad partners that ChatGPT's privacy rules mean some targeting and data requests are off the table, and declined to own the reported $100 billion ad revenue target.

items.title: TIME’s AI Agents Do The Coordinating, And Its Sellers Still Do The Selling | AdExchanger
items.excerpt: TIME is using Kana's AI agents to draft ad-sales proposals and troubleshoot campaigns, while keeping human sellers on the client relationships.

items.title: Publishers: Agentic AI Isn’t About Pricing, But Whether You Get Any Bids At All | AdExchanger
items.excerpt: Sell-side column: AI buying agents can already evaluate inventory and make bid decisions without new pipes, so the publisher risk is being skipped entirely rather than being priced down.

items.title: Google AI Mode Multiturn Ads - Ads In Follow-Up Queries
items.excerpt: Google's Multiturn ads, which place ads on responses to follow-up questions in AI Mode, are now live, with screenshots and video of the format in the wild.

items.title: Microsoft Bing Showing Ads At Top Of AI Mode Results
items.excerpt: Microsoft is now showing both text search ads and shopping ads at the very top of Bing AI Mode (formerly Copilot Search) results.

items.title: Google Ads AI-Generated Summaries Above & Within Search Ads
items.excerpt: Google is testing an AI-generated summary above the block of sponsored results that summarizes all advertisers' ads, plus AI summaries beneath each ad description.

items.title: Paid Search Is Moving Up The Funnel – Google Admits AI Mode Pays Less
items.excerpt: Google has acknowledged AI Mode ad inventory monetizes below classic search; the analysis lays out four account changes for testing the new up-funnel inventory and proving whether it pays.

items.title: Google Ads Tests Asset Activity Page With Weekly AI Insights
items.excerpt: Some Google Ads accounts now show an Asset activity page that delivers weekly AI-generated insight cards on ad creative, including headline ideas to test.

items.title: Google Ads MCP server gains 4 write tools, still can't change budgets
items.excerpt: Google's Ads MCP server v0.0.6 switched on four write tools for assets and labels in default installs, letting AI agents edit live accounts while budgets stay off-limits.

items.title: Adobe and Pepsi ads ran on AI recipe sites with fake chefs, DecryptAds finds
items.excerpt: DecryptAds found Adobe and Pepsi ads running on 2,100+ AI-generated recipe sites fronted by fake AI chefs, most monetized through sales houses HBagency and Ezoic.

items.title: Brainlabs warns Meta's AI creative could leave brands unsure what worked
items.excerpt: Brainlabs warns that as Meta's Muse Image comes to Advantage+ creative, auto-generated ad variants could leave brands unable to tell what actually drove results.

items.title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together
items.excerpt: Disney and Adobe signed a multi-year generative AI alliance giving Disney early access to Adobe AI tools, with marketing tie-ins across five Disney units including resorts, cruise line and ESPN.

items.title: "가짜 의사가 화장품 추천" 했다간…K뷰티, AI 광고 검수 재정비
items.excerpt: 개정 화장품법이 27일 시행되면서 AI로 만든 가짜 의사·전문가가 효능을 설명하는 화장품 광고가 명시적 금지 대상이 되고, K뷰티 업계가 AI 광고 내부 검수 기준을 재정비하고 있다.

items.title: "내 광고 분석해줘"…챗GPT 도입한 당근
items.excerpt: 당근이 광고 MCP를 고도화해 광고주가 ChatGPT·Claude에서 자연어로 광고 성과를 조회하게 하고, 광고 등록·수정 오픈 API까지 개방해 소상공인 광고 운영 자동화에 나섰다.

items.title: 메타, 광고·비즈니스 약관 개정 보류…크롤링 조항 포함
items.excerpt: 메타가 11월 20일 시행 예정이던 상업·광고·생성형 AI 광고 소재 약관 개정을 보류했다. 광고주 사이트 크롤링 허용과 AI가 바꾼 광고 내용의 책임을 광고주에게 지우는 조항이 포함돼 있었다.

items.title: Adobe connects agentic AI with enterprise marketing through OpenAI, Google, Microsoft
items.excerpt: Adobe embedded its CX Enterprise Coworker agent inside ChatGPT, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot so marketers can run campaign and content workflows from those assistants.

items.title: Meta’s AI ads included unapproved discounts
items.excerpt: Reports found Meta's AI-powered ad tools displayed discount offers to customers even when advertisers had promotions turned off, raising questions about guardrails on automated ad creative.

items.title: AI에이전트, 제조사·소비자 직접 연결…“AI와 함께하는 쇼핑, 2년 내 일상 될 것”
items.excerpt: AI 에이전트가 상품 추천부터 구매까지 맡는 쇼핑이 2~3년 안에 일상이 되면서 연간 100조원 규모 미국 리테일 광고 시장도 재편의 갈림길에 섰다는 전망이 나왔다.
